state.revision: immutable initial admission revision 1; no update, replacement or resurrection

1.encoding: exact independently authenticated initial-instance witness for same immutable human candidate, reservation and durable original challenge/attempt; distinct from routine renewal proof

4.encoding: SHA-256 over pc.control.definition-json.v1 actual durable business-parent snapshot

state.digest: pc.control.transition-state.v1; SHA-256 over canonical typed CBOR; every map field required

transition.change: create exact initial instance membership and current initial family under separately installed owning admission; preserve original credential provenance and exact independent witness, consumed challenge, policy and parent links; no issuance, runtime permission, routine renewal, re-enrollment, scope transfer or resurrection
transition.noOp: REJECT_WITHOUT_EFFECTS; exact idempotent readback retains original operation and signed bytes

authority.action: exact action registry, live scoped authority fence

evidence.format: identity credential signed by the authorized checker
evidence.binding: exact immutable candidate, action, scope, expected revision and distinct checker; consumed by this operation
actual operator, session, action, candidate digest and one-time challenge consumed by this operation

authority.snapshot: retained exact precommit authority path and live epochs/validity; no session or credential secrets
authority.approval: EXACT_CONSUMED_CANDIDATE_WITH_INDEPENDENT_MAKER_CHECKER; deferred owning-row trigger binds approval and before/after state
authority.current: actual independent managed registration/profile/deployment/native handle and real live transport, exact ACTIVE policy/current permission and business parents, complete Participant ARCHIVE/credential/instance fences; quota and maxInstances serialized before effect; unknown/uninstalled owner denies
authority.witness: fresh distinct initial-instance proof is staged after stable setup/approval and binds SAME immutable human candidate, original operation/reservation/challenge/attempt; native/provider I/O outside mutation transaction, reconcile original ambiguity, revalidate before consuming governance or challenge; metadata/JSON/schema success is not admission
authority.signing: exact newly admitted profile/key/consumer qualification required; do not widen original338/371 grants or reinterpret manual receipts

events.payload: canonical four-key CommandCommitted CBOR; commandId=operationId, aggregateRef=canonical aggregate URN, actionIntentId, intentDigest=actionIntentDigest
events.effect: one exact initial instance admission and family linkage only; one committed receipt/evidence/event, no certificate issuance or runtime access

privacy.placement: same participant and privacy domain as authoritative aggregate
privacy.read: current read authorization required; receipt is never authorization
privacy.retention: retain exact original instance registration, definition, witness/challenge, credential provenance, signed receipt, business parents and operation links; routine current leaf selection remains separate; no automatic deletion

lifecycle.idempotency: exact replay returns original operation, receipt, evidence and event IDs/bytes/sequences
lifecycle.restart: authoritative scoped original operation/witness/challenge readback; unresolved COMMIT remains UNKNOWN; no new identifiers to bypass a denial or replay a consumed effect
lifecycle.delivery: qualified namespace and profile required; no legacy cursor merge

requestBinding.encoding: UTF-8 domain plus NUL; each field prefixed by uint32 big-endian UTF-8 byte length; SHA-256
